name: Write your Prophecy
source:
The man grips his quill tightly, the yellowed paper is waiting, for the future to be dictated by his words.

[From [url=https://cherbox.itch.io/write-your-prophecy]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
男人紧紧握着羽毛笔，泛黄的纸张等待着，等待着他的话语来决定未来。
